title: Scripture and the Gospel
searchTerms: Word of God and the Gospel
definition: Scripture and the Gospel are joined because the Bible reveals God's saving message concerning sin, grace, Christ, repentance, faith, and eternal life.
summary: The Gospel is not a human idea added to Scripture; it is the good news promised, revealed, and proclaimed through Scripture.
christFocus: Christ died for sins and rose again according to the Scriptures, making Him the heart of the Gospel message.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Scripture and the Gospel teaches that God's people must receive this truth under the authority of the Lord, allowing Scripture itself to define the doctrine rather than personal opinion, tradition, or culture.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it protects the believer from confusion and helps the church remain anchored in what God has actually spoken. Without this truth, faith can drift toward feelings, assumptions, or human wisdom.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: A disciple should respond to scripture and the gospel by reading the Word prayerfully, testing beliefs by Scripture, obeying what God reveals, and helping others handle the Bible with humility, clarity, and faith.

studySections.heading: Guardrails and Common Errors
studySections.content: This doctrine should not be used to win arguments while neglecting love, nor should it be separated from prayer, obedience, and dependence on the Holy Spirit. The goal is faithful submission to God, not mere possession of information.

sources: Scripture references listed in this doctrine entry.
